items.title: Meta spend 2026-09-29 to 2026-10-05: $356.10, 19 leads, CPL $18.74
items.summary: Seven-day window (widened to cover the gap since the last run on 2026-09-08). Flooring Problems Campaign was the only campaign that spent: $356.10, 19 leads, 224 clicks. Account is ACTIVE with no flagged ads.

needs_attention: Last successful meta-ads run was 2026-09-08; window widened to the 7-day cap (2026-09-29 to 2026-10-05). Days 2026-09-09 to 2026-09-28 are not covered.
Single 7-day pull used as both window and baseline, so no per-campaign CPL anomaly comparison was made.
